items.title: Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: That's, Clay Giles is Albert's uncle. ... I just want to get those guys. I can't think of his dad's name.

ctx.x: And, uh, had you played anything before that at all, like drums or guitar or anything?

No, never worried about music. I had the opportunity to learn to play piano, but I was a fast man at the time. Didn't have time to worry with music. See, and, uh, so after that, uh, I went and bought the method and started going up there twice a week. So finally, I got the first, second, and third position and learned how to make those notes in the end. So, uh, after he left, I went with Steve. Well, Steve, well, he wasn't a great musician. Well, I went on to him and taken a couple of lessons with him. So he…
